scope: One cached r13 physical world, reused for legacy equivalence and shared supply; no new geometry, seed search, game or browser execution

supply.patrolWindowContract: 2400ms unalerted-route model, dry full-body station; live approach/pursuit verified separately

metrics.pathOrder: direct exit; node ID; 4x3 region row/column
metrics.pathTie: integer 8-neighbour cost then y,x; equal parent y,x
metrics.interactionChoice: minimum complete spawn-seat-exit graph distance among every legal 48px LOS seat; y,x ties
metrics.smoothing: per leg, greedy farthest feasible 20px swept-body segment

overallEncounters.basis: All complete routes, including short samples; each structure once per route. Repeated structures and shared trunks across routes count again.

metrics.regionalEventBasis: first encounters on the same smoothed complete routes; shared body-edge + identity, then original event region + identity
metrics.shoreBays: Excluded from H/S; no bays promoted to internal holes
metrics.transverseScope: 8px samples; +/-32px local axis; first actual VOID or solid boundary each side within224px; clipped widths are lower bounds; uncertain turns cannot reset a narrow run
metrics.transverseAdmission: Only maxNarrowOrUncertainRunPx is hard; narrowRatio is quality-only. Per-route transverse.accepted retains the original combined diagnostic.
